name: Good Steel

angles.text: With high-grade steel scarce in post-war Elwynn, smiths and craftsmen must scrounge for metal and reuse it from old, abandoned tools.
The picks left behind in Jasperlode Mine show an older, finer standard of metalworking that workers in Elwynn struggle to match today.
Strained supplies across Stormwind's outlying lands leave settlements like Eastvale Logging Camp salvaging abandoned tools to keep working.

aliases: where do i turn in good steel
faq.answer: Hagar Lowe, a craftsman at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest, asks adventurers to salvage good steel equipment from abandoned workings. The camp needs reliable tools.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Good Steel?

aliases: why does hagar want mining tools
faq.answer: Wars have left quality steel scarce, and the camp's tools badly worn. Hagar wants the finely made picks abandoned in Jasperlode Mine so he can reuse their steel for tools used in lumbering.
faq.q: Why does Hagar Lowe need mining tools from Jasperlode Mine?

faq.answer: Jasperlode Mine is an old mining site in north-eastern Elwynn Forest, north of Eastvale Logging Camp. It was overrun and abandoned, leaving finely made mining equipment in its depths.

The Third War and prolonged conflicts disrupted production, supply lines, and trade across the human kingdoms. Resources are stretched thin as the realm is defended and rebuilt, so outlying places like Eastvale salvage durable metal from old tools.
faq.q: Why is good steel in short supply?

faq.answer: Eastvale Logging Camp is Stormwind's main timber settlement, on Elwynn Forest's eastern border near the Redridge Mountains. Its woodcutters supply raw lumber to Stormwind and nearby communities, so reliable tools matter to their work.

The picks left in Jasperlode Mine were forged when craftsmanship was higher and steel was more plentiful. Their lasting shine and durability show Hagar they were made with better steel than is available today.
faq.q: What makes the tools in Jasperlode Mine so special?

sections.body: After the wars that battered the human kingdoms, good steel grows scarce in Elwynn Forest. At Eastvale Logging Camp, woodcutters rely on sturdy axes, saws, and other tools. Constant use and poor metal have worn them down. Without steady shipments from Stormwind's foundries, craftsman Hagar Lowe must keep the camp working with what he can find.
sections.title: A Kingdom's Scarcity

sections.body: North of Eastvale Logging Camp, Jasperlode Mine lies abandoned after its fall. Miners once worked its rich veins with finely made picks, forged when steel was plentiful and expertly tempered. Hagar sends adventurers into the infested tunnels to bring those picks back to Eastvale. Their sound metal can be melted down and made into tools for the camp's lumberjacks.
sections.title: Salvaging the Past

summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Hagar Lowe seeks good steel for the tools worn by its woodcutters. With fine metal scarce after the wars, he sends adventurers to Jasperlode Mine for picks whose steel can be reused.
